effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] This Digimon can digivolve into an [AncientGreymon] in your hand for a memory cost of 2, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If it does, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When you would digivolve this Digimon into an [AncientGreymon] in your hand, reduce its digivolution cost by 2.
